_provenance: Known acronym/full-name pairs for Quebec and major Canadian universities, kept as data per R6 (.claude/rules/code-style.md) so a new institution is a one-line edit here, never a code change. Seeded 2026-10-09 (code-review finding: exact-string university equality in selections.py's no-reuse/cap/conflict-of-interest checks silently bypassed a spelling variant like UQAC vs 'Universite du Quebec a Chicoutimi'). This is a KNOWN-ALIASES lookup, not a fuzzy matcher: an institution not listed here still requires an EXACT normalized match - extend this file when a professor reports a real-world bypass, rather than guessing at a fuzzy-similarity threshold that could introduce its own false positives (two DIFFERENT universities wrongly read as the same one).
